info.title: Commercial Multi-Tenant Automotive CRM and ERP Platform — API
info.summary: Backend foundation (Phase 1-13) plus the authentication, authorization, and administration surface (Phase 1-14).
info.description: Shared components and conventions every later backend phase composes, and the identity and access-administration operations built on them. Sessions are bearer tokens issued by the authentication provider recorded in ADR-019; authorization is evaluated in the database on every request and is never carried in a token. The product name is deliberately absent: it is pending owner approval (ADR-011).

bearerAuth.description: Access token issued by the authentication provider (ADR-019). Verified locally on every request: signature, issuer, audience, algorithm allow-list, expiry, and bounded clock skew. The token proves identity only — permissions and scope are resolved from the database per request, so a revoked grant stops working immediately rather than at token expiry.

ProblemDocument.description: RFC 9457 problem document. Every failure response in this API uses this shape.

code.description: Stable catalog code. Clients branch on this, never on the title.

Money.description: Exact decimal amount as a string plus an ISO-4217 code. Never a JSON number: IEEE-754 cannot represent decimal money exactly.

PageEnvelope.description: Opaque-cursor page. Offset paging is not offered.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key, 8–200 characters. Replaying the same key with the same request returns the original result; the same key with a different request is rejected.

IfMatch.name: if-match
IfMatch.description: Expected record version for optimistic concurrency.

CorrelationId.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller-supplied correlation ID. Accepted only when it is a valid UUID; anything else is replaced with a generated one.
Correlation ID for this request. Present on every response.

ETag.description: Current record version, for optimistic concurrency.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a throttled request.

Problem.description: Failure. Always an RFC 9457 problem document.
